Agent-drafted; corpus approval delegated by the owner for the 2026-10-12 run (ADR-0120 ratification record, decision 5). S1 (2026-10-13, ADR-0121 S1 / ADR-0120 D6 Phase C): every entry with a frozen Class B grammar has at least 25 phrasings that grammar answers in Phase A (agent-drafted; the 148 S1 cases were owner-approved on 2026-10-13, DECISIONS.md "S1 owner decisions (2026-10-13)" decision 2), plus narrowing follow-ups without a previous selection and grammar-adjacent negatives. INT-4 (2026-10-14): 41 more agent-drafted edge cases (v5int4-001..041: typos, spacing errors, mixed language, indirect asks, compound requests, follow-ups with a prior selection, capability-word negatives) were owner-approved in the D12 batch of 2026-10-15 (ADR-0120 D12). GY (2026-10-14, ADR-0120 A2 implementation note 2): 6 more agent-drafted cases (uat5gy-01..06: two live sentences a Class B grammar used to swallow, four plain phrases the grammars still answer with yield on) were owner-approved in the D12 batch of 2026-10-15. WD (2026-10-14, ADR-0120 A5 implementation note 2): 7 more agent-drafted cases (uat5wd-01..07: one-syllable weekdays after a week anchor, and 금 without one) were owner-approved in the D12 batch of 2026-10-15. CA (2026-10-14, calendar-accuracy implementation note): 10 more agent-drafted cases (uat5ca-01..04: bare and anchored weekdays, a one-syllable weekday after 담주; uat5ca-05..10: weekday statements that must stay none) were owner-approved in the D12 batch of 2026-10-15. D12 owner batch 2026-10-15 (A5 implementation note 3): 9 approved-gold relabels approved by the owner (calendar-010, -026, -036, -057 for the A5 availability/partOfDay args; calendar-008, -020, -025, -030, -035 timedOnly, a meeting word = timed events). D12 owner batch 2026-10-15 (second part, through the orchestrator): approved uat5r1..r9 (23 cases from the 2026-10-14 live edge-case run), uat5gy-01..06, uat5wd-01..07, uat5ca-01..10 and the 8 grammar-metadata-only edits of ADR-0120 A2 implementation note 2 (confluence-001, -005, -007, todo-016, -020, brief-017, neg-219, help-038). Still PENDING the owner's batch approval: the 41 INT-4 cases (v5int4-001..041). T1 extension (owner-approved 2026-10-15): calendar-005, -016, -018, -029, -032, -034 and -057 gain timedOnly (a meeting word in a listing question means timed events), the earlier gold kept in each note. A8 (2026-10-15, ADR-0120 amendment A8, Proposed): 28 agent-drafted jira.release cases (a8-01..28: the owner's four live sentences of 2026-10-15 and the release-report link verbatim, release and project names, follow-ups, counts, links) and 7 negatives (a8n-01..07), owner-approved in the D12 batch of 2026-10-15 with the owner's default scope (the owner's own items; every assignee only when said).
